instruction: Please set the background to orange for all slides in my presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing background color to orange (RGB: 255, 165, 0) on all 19 slides. Uses existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance function to verify RGB distance from target color. Original background is white (RGB: 255, 255, 255).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the modified PPTX file from the VM using get_vm_file
Metric function evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance comprehensively checks ALL slides in the presentation, matching the 'all slides' requirement in the instruction
The metric calculates RGB distance from target orange color (255, 165, 0) using Euclidean distance normalization, providing robust color matching with partial credit scoring
Handles both direct slide fills (type 1) and master slide fills (type 5), covering different LibreOffice Impress background configuration methods
Original RGB value (255, 255, 255 - white) is correct for typical presentation default backgrounds
The metric correctly penalizes unchanged slides by returning maximum distance (1.0) when current color matches original_rgb
Postconfig appropriately saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring getter retrieves the final state
Expected RGB values are semantically correct: standard web orange (255, 165, 0) matches the instruction requirement
Distance-based continuous scoring (0.0-1.0) is more robust than binary pass/fail, allowing detection of partial completion or near-matches
